title: Campaign Correspondent
subtitle: Voice Across Eumenes' Lines
bodyText: A campaign correspondent compares dispatches with the movement of forces and the needs of command. Clear writing draws scattered events into focus, allowing distant officers to act with a better understanding of one another.
sceneBrief: A campaign correspondent compares a held dispatch with the map and writing surface under her pen. Keep a slight downward three-quarter head and a natural relaxed neck, with the eyes directed toward the dispatch and pen work. Preserve both hands, pen, papers, map, lamp and campaign tent.
